identification: Six large folio half-leather bound volumes, consistent with Illustrated London News c1850s (title says so; spines and title pages not legible in the single photo). Heavy damage: rubbed stained boards, broken spines, loose and torn leaves. Each volume is normally six months of weekly issues; 1850s volumes carry Crimean War and gold rush engravings. Common title, so only condition and specific year (1851 Great Exhibition, 1854-55 Crimea) lift price.
